title: Tympanoplasty
what: The surgeon closes a hole in the eardrum with a small piece of your own tissue. Sometimes the tiny hearing bones are repaired too.
why: For a hole in the eardrum that does not heal, frequent ear discharge, or reduced hearing.
duration: surgery usually takes 1 to 2 hours; the hospital stay is usually 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when
If you had problems with anesthesia
If you have ear discharge before surgery

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: A hearing test, blood tests, and sometimes a CT scan. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Ear
prepare.text: Before surgery, the ear usually needs to be dry. Do not get it wet.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: The clinic will tell you when to stop eating before anesthesia.

bring: Blood test and hearing test results
steps: An IV line is placed in your vein
The surgeon makes a cut in the ear canal or behind the ear
A piece of tissue is taken and used to close the hole in the eardrum
Packing is placed in the ear
feel: After anesthesia, you may feel sleepy and sometimes sick
Moderate ear pain. You will get pain medicine
The ear feels blocked. Hearing is worse at first because of the packing
after: Do not get the ear wet until your doctor allows
Do not blow your nose hard. Sneeze with your mouth open
No flying or swimming until your doctor allows
The packing is removed at a clinic visit
Hearing is checked after a few weeks
red_flags: A fever over 38°C, or pus from the ear
A severe headache: call emergency services

faq.a: Hearing often gets better, but not always fully. The doctor will tell you what to expect.
Usually after a few weeks. The doctor decides.

reminders.text: Ear surgery tomorrow. Keep the ear dry. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
